request.learning_goal: I want my fourth-grade students to understand force, motion, and engineering design through hands-on experiments.

response.interpreted_goal: Explore how forces affect motion and how engineers test and improve designs through hands-on investigation.

recommendations.ai_educational_reasoning: Varying the catapult setup and observing motion gives students a concrete way to investigate how changes in force relate to movement, then compare test results. This is a close match for the goal’s force-and-motion experiments and engineering inquiry.

museum_facts.description: Students experiment with a rubber-band-powered catapult, varying band count and the position of the supplied ping-pong ball to explore force and motion.

notes: Manual live official-page review completed on 2026-10-21. Published facts are verified as displayed; booking, delivery, and future price validity are not established.
The museum's safety statement is conditional on using its supplied ping-pong ball; this record does not establish a general safety guarantee.
